# Issue **Title:** bug: envvar not working for `typer.Options` with `typer==0.26.0` ## Description Confirmed that this is a regression, we're working on this. ### Discussed in https://github.com/fastapi/typer/discussions/1786
Originally posted by **wpk-nist-gov** May 26, 2026 ### First Check - [X] I added a very descriptive title here. - [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it. - [X] I searched the documentation, with the integrated search. - [X] I already searched in Google "How to X" and didn't find any information. - [X] I already read and followed all the tutorials in the docs and didn't find an answer. ### Example Code ```python from typing import Annotated import typer app = typer.Typer() @app.command("arg") def from_argument(user: Annotated[str, typer.Argument(envvar="ME")]): print(f"Hello {user}") @app.command("opt") def from_option(user: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="ME")]): print(f"Hello {user}") if __name__ == "__main__": app() ``` ### Description The `envvar` option is not respected for `typer.Option`. It is respected for `typer.Argument`. For the above code snippert, with `typer==0.26.0`, I get ```bash ❯ python tmp.py arg foo Hello foo ❯ ME=bar python tmp.py arg Hello bar ❯ python tmp.py opt --user foo Hello foo ❯ ME=bar python tmp.py opt Usage: tmp.py opt [OPTIONS] .... ``` With `typer<0.26.0`, the last one works as expected printing `Hello bar`. ### Operating System macOS ### Operating System Details _No response_ ### Project Version 0.26.0 ### Python Version 3.14 ### Additional Context _No response_
## Task Modify the repository so that the issue described above is resolved. The task's test suite verifies your patch by applying it on top of the base commit `959a356fec72` and running the modified tests.
